questions.question: Explain uncompetitive inhibition and describe how it affects enzyme–substrate complex formation. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain uncompetitive inhibition and describe how it affects enzyme-substrate complex
  • formation. [U] / [CO2]
  • Liberal valuation
  • Definition- 2 marks; an example- 2 marks; effect on Vmax and Km- 1 mark
  • Definition: In this type of inhibition, the inhibitor binds only to the Enzyme-Substrate
  • (ES) complex, not the free enzyme.
  • Effect: It effectively "locks" the substrate in the active site, preventing the reaction from
  • completing. This results in a decrease in both the maximum velocity Vmax and the
  • Michaelis constant (Km)
